nom: COOLA Classic Face Sunscreen Mist SPF 50

segments.sensitive: Reviewers who describe their own skin as sensitive, including some who normally react to skincare products, report this mist does not irritate or burn their skin.
segments.dry: The one reviewer who describes her skin as dry says the mist leaves a sheen she enjoys for a dewy look, and cautions that oily skin might not like the same sheen.
segments.combination: The one reviewer who describes her skin as combination reports the mist does not leave it feeling greasy.

concerns.redness: Most reviewers report no redness or irritation, but several 1-star reviews describe severe reactions after use, including facial swelling, redness, and eye burning that took days to resolve for some, and a separate, more common complaint is that the mist stings or waters the eyes on contact even when the rest of the face is unaffected.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the mist as hydrating or at least not drying, with several noting no tightness afterward; one reviewer says the alcohol content dried her skin out a bit, enough that she limited use to a few times a week instead of daily.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers who describe themselves as acne-prone report the mist did not cause new breakouts and did not clog their pores; no reviewer in this set reports the mist causing blemishes.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers describe the finish as non-greasy and lightweight, but a notable minority, mostly among the lower-rated reviews, say it left their skin looking shiny, oily, or greasy, and one longtime user says a recent formula change made it oilier than the previous version.

extraits.titre: Think twice before wasting your money
extraits.texte: I purchased this thinking it would be easy over makeup. The first and last time I used this product my face and neck were so red, inflamed and swollen i could not open my eyes. My daughter reported this product to the state due to seeing my face the morning after using this. Truly, beware!

extraits.titre: Don't use as solo sun protection
extraits.texte: CONS- First things first- my first purchase arrived opened and spilled all over the box- Coola replaced it- THANKS! But this is a problem. The bottle opened in my purse recently, it was loose and leaking another time. Screw on top seems to be a bad idea. This weekend I used this as my sole sunscreen over my body (extra tinted moisturizer with SPF on my face). I reapplied OFTEN as it was sunny out and I got fried! I was in and out of sun/shade so probably in the sun 3 hours total. I was sweating a lot so would pay dry myself with a handkerchief and thoroughly spray an area again. PROS- I use this on my part line (soak a cotton ball and dab on and it doesn't make hair greasy. Smell isn't awful and over powering. It is non irritating to me and I have horribly sensitive skin.

Coola Face Sunscreen Mist is a convenient spray SPF that is easy to apply. The mist is lightweight, non-greasy, and hydrating on my skin. It absorbs well, and I appreciate that this facial sunscreen did not break out my acne-prone skin or cause irritation. It also did not leave a white cast, which some sunscreens tend to do. Although it claims to be fragrance-free, my sensitive nose can detect a slight scent; however, compared to other sunscreens, it is quite mild. This sunscreen is SPF 50 and waterproof, providing plenty of protection. I tried this mist on its own, as well as under and over makeup, and I was happy with the protection Coola provided. The size of the spray is perfect for portability in my purse, beach bag, or for any outdoor event. I highly recommend this plant-based sunscreen mist. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

extraits.titre: A mist have but can sting a bit
extraits.texte: I am a 33 year old beauty enthusiast from Alabama. I am always looking to add SPF in my beauty routine as I have always believed prevention is one of the key ways to help with anti-aging. I was so excited to add this product into my daily routine as I rarely leave the house without some sort of SPF on. It was very easy to use, and I have used it both over makeup and on makeup free days. From my experience, the alcohol in this mist can sting for a few seconds once I apply it, but it doesn't last long! I feel a mist is perfect for touching up throughout the day especially when you already have makeup on already and want to touch up on SPF! This did dry my skin out a bit, so I personally will not be using it daily, but I will definitely use it a few times a week! **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I absolutely love this product. I went on vacation this month and used this every single day. It applies easily onto the skin and has such a nice smell. It's great for sensitive skin as I didn't find it harsh whatsoever. The packaging is clearly very high quality and even when traveling I had no problem with spillage or any other packaging problems. This sunscreen allowed me to get a tan without the suns harmful UV rays. I love that the spf is high enough that it protects from the sun without completely interfering with your ability to tan. I also noticed that I didn't need to be constantly reapplying this product outside of the application instructions. It stayed on really well throughout the day and even when I went into the ocean. I recommend this to anyone who is going on a trip or just needs daily sun protection. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

extraits.titre: Touch-free way to apply face sunscreen
extraits.texte: I have fair skin, am in my early 30s, and live in New York City. I love that I can spritz the KOOLA SPF on as the last step in my routine, whether or not I'm wearing makeup. It leaves a bit of a sheen, but I don't mind it. I tend to have dry skin so I like the dewy look, but if you have oily skin you might not like the sheen it gives you. I also love that you can reapply it without touching your face since the sunscreen in a spray bottle. I keep a bottle of this SPF in my bag for times when I'm out because I can apply it even if there's no sink nearby the wash my hands. Even though it's a regular spray bottle, if you hold down it sprays a little longer (almost like an aerosol) which is nice for a controlled mist. There is a light juniper smell. (It almost smells like a gin and tonic?) But the smell is only initial and then it disappears. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Last year I tried Coola for first time and I have been loving their products ever since. This mist is another amazing skincare product! It is so convenient to use in my daily routine after my skincare in the morning or to refresh during day. I live in Florida so daily SPF is a must for me regardless of time of year. Mist itself is super fine and feels moisturizing on my skin after using. Nozzle sprays well and equal without spitting. Additionally, I really like that it doesn't my combo skin feel greasy after using it like some other products. It has very slight, maybe herbal scent which disappears quickly. Size of the mist is big enough to last me a while, but small enough to carry it in my purse. Overall I am very impressed with this mist and will be definitely buying more in the future! Definitely recommend trying it! **This review was collected as part of a promotion.
